understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level, while continuing through levels until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions shift the player, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a spike, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. Landing on spike tiles ends the attempt. CLICK targets a coordinate and removes clickable breakable blocks without changing the player position; clicks do not advance the rising-platform timer. UNDO reverts the previous action. The landing previews and corridor scan indicate safe destinations and passage columns, which should be used to plan movement.
